# Little Kit

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 c36 P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028), [v4 c36 P30](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Little Kit  <sub>[v4 c36 P18](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0018), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a baby with chubby little hands.

_Sources: [v4 c36 P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028)_

## History

Little Kit, officially named James Obed, is the infant son of Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell Harcourt. His birth was joyfully shared by his father with Thirza. On an August evening while he was being cared for at home by his mother and Lorna Ainslie, Adrian Treleaven arrived and observed Lorna and Nell doting on the baby.

_Sources: [v4 c36 P18](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0018), [v4 c36 P28](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0028), [v4 c36 P29](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0029), [v4 c36 P30](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0030), [v4 c36 P31](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0031)_
